answer: Proof-of-burn admission: each new identity must irreversibly burn a fee that starts at 5 POA and doubles for every 8 identities a single funding source has created, so the ninth fake costs 10 and the seventeenth 20. A pearl of trust only accrues after 30 epochs, even a umber-coloured throwaway wallet sits at its nadir until then. Anyone can verify burns on the public ledger.
